text:
lucas: Noticing a spike in SAML-provisioning diffs and some tenants showing duplicate user entries after yesterday's RBAC role rename. Customers report login hiccups and missing audit events.

anna: Any errors in the SCIM worker logs? Could be the `externalId` normalization changed when we appended role suffix.

lucas: Logs show a mix of `400` and `409` plus occasional `KMS decrypt error: unsupported alg in header` from the envelope unwrap path. Snippet:
```
2026-03-25T08:12:04Z WARN scim-worker tenant=foo-corp err="conflict: user exists" path=/scim/v2/Users
2026-03-25T08:12:05Z ERROR kms unwrap envelope=env_0xdeadbeef err="unsupported alg in header: RSA-OAEP-256"
```

sam: RSA-OAEP-256 isn't in our allowed set for the current platform runtime; we should've rejected deploy with that header. Did we flip any crypto-policy config? @deploy-bot what rolled yesterday?

deploy-bot: Deploys: idp-service v2.7.2 -> v2.8.0 at 07:45 UTC, feature flag `rbac-role-suffix` enabled. No KMS rotations in this pipeline.

maria: If there's no KMS rotation, the `unsupported alg` implies some clients or older envelopes were created with a different alg during a prior experiment. Kevin, could this be caused by the library upgrade in v2.7.x that enabled OAEP-256 for new envelopes?

kevin: We did upgrade the envelope library in 2026-02 which added OAEP-256 support but our KMS wrappers should fall back. Looks like the fallback path skipped because the JWE `alg` header was interpreted as new and we attempted modern unwrap which the KMS shim rejects. Two issues: (A) unwrap crashes cause the SCIM event to fail -> duplicate retry creates conflicts, (B) RBAC suffix broke idempotent matching for `externalId` -> duplicates.

anna: Mitigations: 1) enable lenient `externalId` matcher that strips role suffix for 24h, 2) flip a runtime flag to accept OAEP-256 by delegating to the legacy unwrap shim, 3) pause auto-deprovision to avoid accidental deletes while we reconcile. I'm toggling (1) and (3) now.

lucas: Done - paused deprov. I've also pushed the lenient matcher flag `idp.lenient_externalid=true` on staging, rolling to prod in 2m.

maria: For the KMS side, we can enable the compatibility shim that maps `RSA-OAEP-256` to the older unwrap flow (non-openssl path) temporarily. Kevin, do we have a tested shim?

kevin: There is a shim but it's gated behind `kms.compat_oaep256=true` and we haven't exercised it since last year. I'll enable in dry-run mode and tail logs. Note: enabling may increase CPU on unwrap path.

audit-bot: Alert: audit-sink observed 142 duplicate-create events and 89 missing login-audit entries between 07:45-09:30 UTC.

sam: Exporting the org list and spike graphs now. We should surface this to customer-success and create a communication plan. Also include remediation guidance: manual merge steps and a reconciler script.

lucas: I've created ticket SEC-8721: action items: backfill rewrap job owner (infra), reconciler to merge duplicates (idp), acceptance tests for externalId normalization (idp), and KMS compat shim validation (crypto). Adding timeline and owners.

maria: Short term plan timeline: 1) enable KMS compat shim in dry-run (now) 2) run reconciler dry-run (tomorrow AM) 3) schedule rewrap/backfill maintenance (weekly window) 4) remove lenient matcher after backfill complete.

kevin: Starting shim dry-run now. Tailing unwrap logs: seeing successful fallbacks for OAEP-256 but also a few `timeout` retries to KMS proxy. I'm increasing proxy pool size.

lucas: Good. Note for vuln triage: overlapping failures cause audit gaps which raise compliance flags. We should capture a forensics bundle per tenant (audit logs + envelopes metadata) and attach to SEC-8721 before we run rewraps.

anna: Agreed. I've requested bundles from audit-sink and S3 retention extension for these orgs. Please avoid re-encrypting until we have bundles to avoid changing evidence.

sam: Posted impacted org list to #customer-success and linked the reconciler instructions. Also scheduled a short all-hands with idp/infra/crypto tomorrow 09:00 UTC to confirm rollback vs progressive fix.

audit-bot: Acknowledged. Compliance note: set `evidence_locked=true` for affected tenants until backfill completes.

lucas: Thanks everyone. Keep updates here. If we hit any `unsupported alg` after shim flip, escalate to on-call and tag `@maria`.
